header.running_head: 3. The Rights and Duties of Muslims

blocks.narrator: Hazrat Muhammad ibn Abdullah ibn Jahsh (RA)
blocks.arabic_text: ظَهْرَيْنَا، فَرَفَعَ رَسُوْلُ اللهِ ﷺ بَصَرَهُ قِبَلَ السَّمَاءِ، فَنَظَرَ ثُمَ طَاْطَاَ بَصَرَهُ، وَوَضَعَ يَدَهُ عَلَي جَبْهَتِهِ، ثُمَّ قَالَ: سُبْحَانَ اللهِ! سُبْحَانَ اللهِ! مَاذَا نَزَلَ مِنَ التَّشْدِيْدِ! قَالَ: فَسَكَتْنَا يَوْمَنَا وَلَيْلَتَنَا فَلَمْ نَرَهَا خَيْرًا حَتَّي اَصْبَحْنَا، قَالَ مُحَمَّدٌ: فَسَاَلْتُ رَسُوْلَ اللهِ ﷺ مَا التَّشْدِيْدُ الَّذِيْ نَزَلَ؟ قَالَ: فِي الدَّيْنِ، وَالَّذِيْ نَفْسُ مُحَمَّدٍ بِيَدِهِ لَوْ اَنَّ رَجُلاً قُتِلَ فِيْ سَبِيْلِ اللهِ ثُمَّ عَاشَ ثُمَّ قُتِلَ فِيْ سَبِيْلِ اللهِ ثُمَّ عَاشَ وَعَلَيْهِ دَيْنٌ مَادَخَلَ الْجَنَّةَ حَتَّي يُقْضَي دَيْنُهُ.
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Muhammad ibn Abdullah ibn Jahsh (RA) narrates: “One day we were gathered in the open courtyard of the masjid where the janazah (bier) is brought and placed. Rasulullah ﷺ was also sitting among us. The Prophet ﷺ raised his gaze towards the sky and looked at something. Then he lowered his gaze. (As if troubled by some worry) he placed his hand on his blessed forehead and” said: Subhan Allah! Subhan Allah! What a severe warning has come down!” Hazrat Muhammad ibn Abdullah (RA) says: “That day, that night and until the next morning, all of us remained silent. We did not consider this silence to be good. (The next morning) I asked the Prophet ﷺ: “What is the severe warning that has come down?” “The severe warning has come down concerning debt. By the One in Whose hand is the life of Muhammad! If a man is martyred (giving his life) in the path of Allah Ta'ala, then is brought back to life, then is martyred (giving his life) again, then is brought back to life again, and he owes a debt, he will not be able to enter Jannah until his debt is paid off,”
